vinilux.services: Fine wine selection · Tasting workshops · Food & wine pairings

chef.name: Félicien Christe
chef.bio1: Originally from the Lyon area of France, Félicien Christe began his career in pastry at the age of 17, driven by an absolute passion for flavour and culinary creation. After training at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Chamonix, he travelled to Australia to perfect his English before joining the iconic London institution The Savoy.
chef.bio2: In 2015, he took the helm of the kitchens at the 5-star Guarda Golf Hotel & Residences in Crans-Montana, Switzerland, where his restaurant FIVE was awarded 14 points by Gault & Millau 2022. A master of creative, uncompromising cuisine, Félicien tailors every experience to the occasion.
chef.awardLabel: Restaurant FIVE — Guarda Golf Hotel & Residences, Crans-Montana
chef.career4: Executive Chef, Guarda Golf Hotel & Residences, Crans-Montana (since 2015)
chef.note: Available by reservation for private dinners, corporate seminars, festive brunches or exclusive celebrations at Villa R.E.E.L.

elegance.name: Elegance Events Organisation
elegance.desc: Specialising in premium event planning, Elegance Events turns every celebration into an exceptional moment. Intimate weddings, engagements, birthdays or private parties: Hatice and her team orchestrate every detail with elegance and precision to make your event at Villa R.E.E.L an unforgettable memory.
elegance.services: Weddings · Engagements · Birthdays · Private parties · Day-of coordination

sofya.name: Maison Sofya
sofya.desc: Maison Sofya imagines and creates unique atmospheres to elevate your events. Floral decoration, table scenography, lighting design and ambiance creation: each project is tailor-made to harmonise with the exceptional setting of Villa R.E.E.L.
sofya.services: Floral decoration · Scenography · Lighting design · Ambiance creation

saanesu.desc: Saanesu supports SMEs, artisans and local businesses in creating professional websites and custom business tools. Reliable, clear and results-driven solutions to boost your visibility, streamline your operations and support your day-to-day business.
